# Support

Thanks for using or reviewing NexusRWA.

## Questions and Help

- For usage questions or bugs, please open a
  [GitHub issue](https://github.com/skymiss18/casper-agentic-buildathon/issues).
- For security concerns, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) instead of opening a
  public issue.
- For general project context (architecture, deployment proof, judging
  criteria mapping), see the root [README.md](../README.md).

## Maintainer

This project is maintained by the repository owner

submission.
